title: Stall warning ignores a worker waiting on its own background work, and lost background notices
notes: Rescoped by the night retro 2026-11-28 (the 'lost background notices' premise was wrong: all 11 background waits woke on their own; the sessions were frozen machine-wide). Wanted, in src/main/workers/stall.ts and its notices: (1) a worker paused on its own background work (a review loop run as a background workflow, a long check) is not called stalled, up to PAUSE_CEILING_MS; (2) a warning names the tool call still in flight when there is one ('Bash has been running 31 min: <description>'), so main can tell stuck from slow: kamandsystem's main released a working pane at 23:05 on a bare 'no sign of life' and the replacement redid its work; (3) when every session (workers and mains) goes silent at once, one notice says 'nothing on the machine has answered since HH:MM' instead of one warning per pane, and the per-pane warnings are held until something answers again (four were delivered at once at 02:35:48).
